usedFor: Encharge holds marketing contacts, and Google Drive shares a file through “Share File With Anyone” after “Tag Added To Person”.

bestTemplate.name: “Tag Added To Person” in Encharge, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A tag marks a person as ready for something, and the action makes a file reachable by link.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” opens the file to anyone with the link, so check the access level first.
